POSE 1 (Top Left): ISSUE - Spine rigid, limbs stiff, unnatural crouch.
POSE 2 (Top Middle): OK - Balanced landing, limbs positioned for impact.
POSE 3 (Top Right): ISSUE - Balance off-center, right leg hyperextended, spine awkward.
POSE 4 (Bottom Left): ISSUE - Torso twisted unnaturally, limbs disjointed, poor balance.
POSE 5 (Bottom Middle): OK - Natural stride, good weight distribution, relaxed posture.
POSE 6 (Bottom Right): ISSUE - Spine arched excessively, limbs flailing, unstable balance.
